title: The Pepper Road
logline: A caravan has lost its pepper sacks on the hill road before the evening tide. {name} borrows a bamboo staff, learns to keep trouble at arm's length and carries the sacks to the harbour.

objectives.text: Cross the stone wall and find Poonkodi at the bamboo grove.
Duck under the bamboo beam and reach the caravan camp.
Bring the sacks to the harbour scales before the tide turns.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: {name}, a staff is only a longer arm. It keeps trouble away from you, and from those walking behind you.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: A wall first. I can vault that. Then the grove.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Good. Hold it low and let it turn a charge aside. Never swing at a person who has stopped.

dialogue.speaker: Caravan master
dialogue.text: My sacks are scattered along the road. Gather them before the tide, and I will pay you in pepper.

dialogue.speaker: Harbour clerk
dialogue.text: Three sacks, all sealed. You carried this alone, {name}? Keep that staff. It is yours now.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: One sack. Two more somewhere on this road.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Good. A raider turned aside is a raider who goes home. No need for more.

dialogue.speaker: {name}
dialogue.text: A raider has seen me. Keep the staff low and keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: Steady. Your feet first, then the staff.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: The tide waits for no one. Come back to the grove and try the road again.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: {name}, you walked the whole road and nobody was badly hurt. That is what the staff is for.

dialogue.speaker: Poonkodi
dialogue.text: A shield bearer stops what comes from the front. Walk round him, or shove his guard open.
